claims: The 2026 Oscars are the 98th Academy Awards.
The 2026 Oscars air live on ABC on Sunday, March 15, at 7 p.m. ET/4 p.m. PT.
The 2026 Oscars are available to stream on Hulu's live service.
Red carpet coverage begins on ABC at 12:30 p.m.
Red carpet coverage begins on Hulu at 12:30 p.m.
The 2026 Oscars are on ITV1 in Britain.
YouTube will become the new home of the Oscars beginning in 2029.
